title: Mitiyan Ton Chaee Shah Nay Ibn-e-Hasan
body:
Mitiyan Ton’ Chaee Shah Nay, Ibn-e-Hasan Di Mehndi
Ummath Nay Rol Chori, Ik Bai Watan Di Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuj Dayr Banrayaan Nu, Kerbal Day Rukh Bithavan
Teri Yaad Ker Kay Rovan, Us Bay Kafan Di Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Raj Kay Na Waikhee Maa Nay, Qasim Teri Jawani
Kyun Laa Laee Ey Bachra, Aj Tu Maran Di Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghash Kha Kay Dig Paeeyan San, Phupiyan Tai Behnan Mavan
Jadon Khaymayanch Aaee, Farwaa Day Chan Di Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah Da Wastaa’ee, Bharjaee Waikh Aa Kay
Terai Putar Na La Laee, Nayzay Charan Di Mehndi
<<DIVIDER>>
Chun Chun Kay Jholi Paway, Bachra Najaf Day Shah Da
Jug Tai Naee Hor Honee, Matam Keran Di Mehndi
